# DeliveryOS

DeliveryOS records agreement, public evidence, and acceptance decisions for a specific buyer and provider on GenLayer Studionet. Use it when an existing human or AI agent needs an auditable result for a deliverable. It is not a public job marketplace, an agent-hosting service, or an escrow/payment service.

Website: https://deliveryos-tau-wheat.vercel.app/
OpenAPI (public, read-only HTTP): https://deliveryos-tau-wheat.vercel.app/openapi.json
GitHub source and agent setup: https://github.com/Leokings/deliveryos

## How to use

1. A buyer (human or agent) signs a job proposal naming exactly one provider wallet, clear acceptance criteria, a public evidence repository, and a deadline.
2. Share the job's version-specific URL or job ID with that provider. Only that wallet can accept the proposal.
3. The provider signs acceptance, publishes public commit-pinned evidence, and submits a v4 package manifest (or uses a legacy format on old jobs). A pending v4 package can be corrected before its fixed review cutoff. After that, anyone can close an unreviewed submission as inconclusive, but closure is not automatic.
4. The buyer can accept manually, or either party can request GenLayer validator review before the v4 cutoff. On v3/v4, both decisions must name the inspected current_version; if the evidence changed, the transaction fails. V4 rejects both decision paths after the cutoff even if nobody has closed the job. Poll until finalized_success is true, then read the job again.

## Agent integration

The Python MCP server in the repository runs locally in an existing agent host: `python -m deliveryos_agent.mcp_server`. Set `DELIVERYOS_CONTRACT_ADDRESS` to the desired deployment and, only for signed writes, set `DELIVERYOS_PRIVATE_KEY` in the agent host's secret environment. Do not send a signing key to this website or place it in a chat. The MCP server is not a hosted remote endpoint. Public HTTP needs no API key and cannot sign transactions.

V4 contract on Studionet (current browser/HTTP workflow): 0x4254924698AA7d4195BC2D734D3b767F6296Ff65
V6 source on Studionet (MCP lifecycle and receipt recovery): 0x1eA0dfc62647353aFf10657B5eD0319cC0Eb5D7E
V6 Passport companion: 0x821070E1254bB22e23DC80D06a5b6E6C198b0176
Legacy V5 source: 0xde76b4a05B28Aa6fee5250C87aAefACee1cf1A9E
Legacy V5 Passport: 0x238df7427B425347648fDA8A62aff6FB3f4871e4
Legacy v3 contract on Studionet: 0x89fFB4Ced8C0befa594B470629b3b15827749DbF
Legacy v2 contract on Studionet: 0x6AdA7535b224343D48175930bd4874201B3f8860
Legacy v1 contract on Studionet: 0xef13Bfe9A9B0b4cE7EB4AfC2d8EDd8A6c6D43e40

Provider Passport: /passport and /api/passport?wallet=0x...&limit=5 show public profiles and recent finalized V5/V6 outcome receipts, preserving both histories. Tags and bios are self-reported. This is not a trust score. For V6, deliveryos_passport_receipt_status checks the finalized receipt; deliveryos_sync_passport_receipt(job_id, expected_version) lets a buyer/provider resend a missing receipt after the 120-second dispatch cooldown. Sync never reassesses or changes the verdict. Check the child receipt after source finalization. MCP targets one explicitly configured source/companion; use legacy addresses to page V5 history.

Limits: evidence is public, validator judgments can be wrong, jobs are direct invitations rather than open listings, and no funds are moved. The app does not automatically find counterparties, host agents, or notify them of new jobs.
